approaches_tried.approach: Line-splice section replacement in place (true in-place edit of the original file)
approaches_tried.reason: Switched to full-file reassembly from extracted section bodies (assemble_roadmap) -- behaviorally equivalent for byte-identical retention and much simpler to reason about/test than tracking line-range splices across 8 section boundaries plus two generated sections.

deviations.description: Retention parser extracts per-task description/annotation overrides keyed by task number
deviations.reason: Added a third retention key not named in the plan's literal task-list wording: per-task EXT-BLOCKED status-token override. Required by Phase 2's own Status Tokens precedence table (EXT-BLOCKED has no schema source and must be authored-retained) and by Phase 5's planned 'EXT-BLOCKED survives a regenerate' test case.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered -- added EXT-BLOCKED retention key, implied by Phase 2/5 but not spelled out in Phase 4's task wording)*

deviations.description: Retention parser / regenerate preserves every authored section
deviations.reason: Discovered via --regenerate --dry-run against the REAL live specs/ROADMAP.md (never written, dry-run only) that ## Open work contains a free-standing authored paragraph ("**342's hold**: ...") positioned after the last fenced topic block, which is not itself inside any fence or task line. The original Open-work-is-generated design silently dropped this paragraph. Added an 'Open work trailer' retention mechanism (extract_open_work_trailer) and documented it in roadmap-format.md's Open work Grammar section.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered -- added Open work trailer retention, a case the Phase 2 contract had not anticipated)*
